findings: Valar's current biographies expose three direct historical personnel bridges into Thiel Capital and Clarium:James Fitzgerald, Erin Porterfield and Andrew McCormack.
James Fitzgerald served as Thiel Capital COO and General Counsel and helped manage Founders Fund and Clarium through that role.
Andrew McCormack helped launch Clarium and rejoined Thiel Capital in 2008 to lead international initiatives.
Ajay Royan founded Mithril with Peter Thiel and previously invested at Clarium.
The Palantir employee PAC reported $82,414.41 in receipts, $95,283.32 in disbursements and $56,444.16 ending cash for posted coverage through June 30, 2026.
Corporate-primary biography evidence corroborates patent inventor Andrew Colombi as an early Palantir employee who led the commercial-sector engineering launch and began the Foundry product.
An official nonprofit release places Palantir government-affairs leader Mehdi Alhassani on the John F. Kennedy Library Foundation board and states that he reports directly to Alex Karp.
Patent US11870666B2 exposes nine technical inventors tied to a Palantir-assigned asset; inventor status is not classified as employment without corroboration.

No exact official WEF identity match was established in the bounded sweep for Ajay Royan, the three Valar bridge personnel, or the nine patent inventors. Search misses remain coverage gaps, not absence claims.
limitations: Three WEF participant PDFs from prior depths remain unavailable for direct acquisition and hashing.
Patent inventor status does not by itself establish employment.
The FEC public page provides posted committee totals but not a fully normalized all-cycle contributor ledger in this pass.
